title: LAquis SCADA Web Server URI Parsing Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on vulnerable installations of LAquis SCADA Software. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of URIs by the product's web server. A crafted URI can cause the web service to bypass authentication that should be required for the web page. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to access system information.
